newsitem.title: USA: Y&R's WCJ/New York says names Coombs president.
newsitem.headline: Y&R's WCJ/New York says names Coombs president.

text.p: Wunderman Cato Jackson Worldwide said Monday it named Janet Coombs president of WCJ/New York, the flagship of its 68-office network.

A company spokesman said Wunderman Cato is a division of Young & Rubicam Inc, a privately held company. The company said Coombs replaces Barbara Jack, who promoted to worldwide's chief executive April 3.
The company said Coombs was chairman and chief executive of Chapman Agency, a Young & Rubicam direct marketing agency.
